• Churchill Brothers SC vs NorthEast United FC || Match Content || Highlights || Match 24 || 05-Nov-2026 || English ||
The Highlanders roll on! Watch the big moments as NorthEast United FC beat Churchill Brothers SC 2-0 in Fatorda to stay unbeaten in the MG Indian Super League 2026-27.
Ethyan González gave NorthEast the lead midway through the first half. Churchill Brothers pushed for an equaliser with 15 shots, but Gurmeet Singh made four saves, and Antonio Moyano made sure of the points in stoppage time.
Match highlight: Both of Moyano’s goals this season have come in stoppage time.
